title: AARYA Voice Lab Segment Record
description: A single traceable audio segment record within a dataset manifest. Describes provenance and processing status for one candidate slice of a source recording. This schema stores no audio data itself.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record conforms to (semver).

segment_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this segment.

source_file_id.description: Identifier of the original source recording this segment was derived from. Never a filesystem path to the private audio.

source_start.description: Start offset in seconds within the source recording.

source_end.description: End offset in seconds within the source recording.

speaker_id.description: Recording-local speaker label assigned by diarization (e.g. 'spk_0'). NOT assumed globally consistent across source files.

diarization_source.description: Name/version of the primary diarization system used (e.g. 'nemo-sortformer-4.x').

diarization_confidence.description: Confidence score reported by the primary diarization system.

independent_verification_status.description: Result of the secondary/independent verification system.

confidence_classification.description: Combined confidence classification from the two-system verification (see docs/SECURITY.md).

overlap_status.description: Whether overlapping speech was detected in this segment.

transcript.description: Transcript text for this segment, once transcription has run. Null before that stage.

audio_quality.description: Free-form quality metrics (e.g. snr_db, clipping_ratio) produced by quality filtering. Structure may evolve; validated loosely on purpose.

acceptance_status.description: Final manual-review/acceptance status for dataset inclusion.

rejection_reason.description: Human-readable reason when acceptance_status is 'rejected' or target_speaker_status is 'reject'.

processing_version.description: Version tag of the pipeline/code that produced this record, for reproducibility.
